pr.title: fix(Email Trigger (IMAP) Node): Fix emails marked as read without triggering workflow
pr.body:
## Summary

Fixes several bugs in the IMAP Email Trigger node that could cause emails to be marked as read without triggering the workflow, or cause duplicate executions.

Ticket: https://linear.app/n8n/issue/NODE-5032

- Add null check for HEADER part in `simple` format — prevents silent workflow deactivation when the IMAP server returns a malformed message
- Only mark successfully processed emails as read, not all fetched messages — the IMAP `UID X:*` range is inclusive, so previously-processed messages were being re-flagged
- Update `lastMessageUid` between batch iterations — prevents duplicate emissions when processing 20+ emails in the batching loop

Community report: https://community.n8n.io/t/imap-not-triggering/120280
Closes https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/issues/28392

## Test plan

- [x] I have seen this code, I have run this code, and I take responsibility for this code.
- [x] New unit tests for all three fixes (4 new tests, 1 updated)
- [x] All existing IMAP v2 tests pass (11/11)
- [x] `pnpm typecheck` passes
- [x] `pnpm lint` passes (no new errors)
- [ ] Manual verification with a real IMAP server

review_comments.body:
This makes one `addFlags` call per email instead of one per batch, which might have a perf impact.

Could we keep the batched call, but collect UIDs as emails are successfully processed and flush them in a `finally`?

reviews.body:
**No issues found** across 2 files

<details>
<summary>Architecture diagram</summary>

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant IMAP as IMAP Server
    participant Trigger as Email Trigger (IMAP) Node
    participant Workflow as Workflow Engine
    participant StaticData as Workflow Static Data
    participant Logger

    Note over IMAP,Logger: Email polling loop (batch processing)

    loop Poll cycle
        Trigger->>IMAP: search() for new emails (UID range)
        IMAP-->>Trigger: results[] (batched messages)

        alt Format is "simple"
            loop Each message in results
                Trigger->>Trigger: Filter parts by HEADER
                alt HEADER part missing or empty
                    Trigger->>Logger: warn("Skipping email UID X: HEADER part missing")
                    Trigger->>Trigger: continue (skip message)
                else HEADER present
                    Trigger->>Trigger: Parse headers, build newEmail object
                    Trigger->>Trigger: Push to newEmails[]
                end
            end
        else Format is "raw" or "auto"
            loop Each message in results
                Trigger->>Trigger: Parse message, build email object
                Trigger->>Trigger: Push to newEmails[]
            end
        end

        Trigger->>Trigger: maxUid = max of processed UIDs

        alt Post-process action is "read"
            loop Each successfully parsed email
                Trigger->>IMAP: addFlags([singleUID], '\SEEN')
                IMAP-->>Trigger: ok
            end
        end

        Trigger->>Workflow: onEmailBatch(newEmails)
        Workflow-->>Trigger: continue

        alt maxUid > lastMessageUid
            Trigger->>StaticData: Update lastMessageUid = maxUid
        end

        alt results.length < EMAIL_BATCH_SIZE
            Note over Trigger: Exit loop (no more emails)
        else results.length >= EMAIL_BATCH_SIZE
            Note over Trigger: Continue loop for next batch
        end
    end
```
</details>

commits.message:
fix(Email Trigger (IMAP) Node): Fix emails marked as read without triggering workflow

- Add null check for HEADER part in simple format to prevent silent
  workflow deactivation when IMAP server returns malformed messages
- Only mark processed emails as read, not all fetched messages
- Update lastMessageUid between batch iterations to prevent duplicate
  emissions when processing 20+ emails
- Serialize concurrent onMail callbacks to prevent race conditions

  successful processing instead of batching
